urban_rooms.dominant_mission: public explanation and low-risk public trial
define real civic problems and beneficiaries
affordable everyday support for creators and residents
publicly reviewable failure, suspension, and rollback

building_and_public_realm_rules: Retain and adapt before adding new volume; no project-specific demolish-retain decision is made without official and professional evidence.
Keep visible making, staffed service, and free rest on the public ground floor where conditions permit.
Separate public wayfinding from sponsor identity and commercial calls to action.
Do not expose high-risk equipment directly to high-footfall public interfaces.
Do not sever the nine transverse urban-room connections with permanent exclusive enclosures.
Set any dimensions, capacity, height, setback, fire, heritage, and municipal controls only after official inputs and professional review.
disclaimer: This control code is a planning and operating concept. It is not a statutory overlay, official redline, engineering standard, land-use approval, or permit.
